payload.text: Molt 1.4.6 rollout, DONE 9 Nov on all three sleeves, nothing owed. hv ran 'molt upgrade --self && molt upgrade && molt maintain' himself on rhadamanth, gyges and kovacs; every sleeve reads 'molt 1.4.6 (brew, f2d262767020)', read first-hand by vc on rhadamanth, by gyges-sysadm on gyges and by kovacs-sysadm on kovacs, each with doctor passing. Tap at 94e58f54, formula pinning tag v1.4.6 at revision f2d2627670208c73d92ae3efb5ad559f5d50fe77. Gap recorded rather than closed: nobody captured hv's own upgrade and maintain runs, only the state afterwards. 0099 proven on kovacs, the one sleeve that migrates, and its met proof is written up on issue 0099 itself: apparmor.service active (exited) since 11:09:55 +04, reload exiting 0/SUCCESS, 'systemctl --failed' empty, nested bwrap rc 0. 1.4.6 also validated independently by AE's devvm image, which took it from the tap 20 minutes after the cut and passed doctor on WSL2, exercising 0094, 0095 and 0097, though on the path where 0099's code does nothing. TWO SYSADM FLAGS ANSWERED, no Molt change needed. First: doctor's absent 'env' check is not a check gone quiet. env_check is the env liberator's, its reporters emit only on a fault (molt_env_report_faults, lib/env.sh:354), so a clean one is silent and doctor folds it into 'Checking enabled liberators... all installed'; 'molt status' shows the healthy case positively as 'env: installed' with no Zen: line. CAUSE CORRECTED (gyges-sysadm, 9 Nov, with dated notes; vc's first account was wrong): the warning was cleared by 9416519 of 30 Oct, which made the check read launchctl print's GUI domain instead of getenv, and which git confirms is an ancestor of v1.3.0; gyges's doctor passed every check on 1.3.0 on 3 Nov, so today's upgrade re-running env_install is NOT what cleared it, as vc had guessed. Second: the iTerm2 ssh wrapper does have a staleness check, _zsh_iterm2_ssh_colors_fault at liberators/zsh.sh:131 from zsh_check at 208, covered by test/liberators/zsh.bats:159 and green as test 668 in today's gate, so gyges-sysadm's 23 Oct report against e9e37f8 is fixed. Still open and untouched by any of this: whether launchd's published PATH reaches a newly started macOS GUI app, which is issue 0072's.
